fields.description: Named in bold at the top of the sidebar, and in the workspace switcher.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: A disabled workspace is offered to nobody. Disable every workspace and the sidebar falls back to the one this app ships.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Lucide name, such as lucide-inbox. The mark beside this workspace in the switcher. Only the icons this app's build compiles can be drawn; saving tells you which.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: The 32px mark at the top of the sidebar. Left blank it is this app's own logo.
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: Where this workspace sits in the switcher. Equal numbers fall back to the title.
fields.label: Order

fields.description: The sidebar rows, top to bottom. Rows sharing a heading, one after another, are drawn as one collapsible group; a row with no heading stands on its own.
fields.label: Rows
